shared_elements: horizontal band dividing the surface into upper and lower zones
row of small repeated motifs along the upper edge
small figures arranged in loose scatter or file below a band
justification: Both surfaces are organised around a strong horizontal division with a row of small repeated units in the upper zone and larger, profile-oriented figures scattered or filed beneath it, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, painted composition of thin dark linear silhouettes against a red-and-white ground, while B is a three-dimensional carved relief on a shaped stone block with modelled animal bodies and a chevron band, so the manner of making and the whole visual effect have almost nothing in common.
